title: phlegmariurus ophioglossoides
intro: Phlegmariurus ophioglossoides, commonly known as the Ophioglossoides forked polypody, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a type of lycopod, a group of ancient, vascular plants. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus ophioglossoides include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antipyretic agent, due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids.
